normalization_plan.reason: _from parameter is only consumed by transferFrom for authorization and balance bookkeeping
_to parameter is only consumed by transferFrom as the recipient of the credit
_value parameter flows directly into the unchecked arithmetic inside transferFrom
target address a is only used by delegate for the delegatecall
calldata b is forwarded verbatim into the unsafe delegatecall operation
spender parameter is only consumed by the privileged _mints balance overwrite
addedValue parameter is the operand of the unchecked mint multiplication
saleNum parameter is stored into _saleNum only by init
token parameter is only used by init to derive _minSale
maxToken parameter is only used by init to derive _maxSale
_tos array parameter is only used by the owner-only batchSend loop
_value parameter is the operand of the unchecked batch total multiplication
addr parameter is only consumed by the owner-only setTradeAddress setter
total local variable holds the unchecked product computed in batchSend
_to loop local is a transient recipient variable inside batchSend
